name: sota
description: Open-source AI Smart Glass companion for visually impaired users (Korea PoC & MVP)

scripts.pre-pr: node --experimental-strip-types -e 'import { execSync } from "node:child_process"; const files = execSync("git ls-files", { encoding: "utf8" }).split("\n"); const banned = ["ONE_PAGER.md", "PRD.md", "linear-backlog.ts", "triage-feedback.ts", "mcp_config.json", "feedback-triage", "feedback-logs/"]; const leaked = files.filter(f => banned.some(b => f.includes(b))); if (leaked.length) { console.error("❌ Blocked internal files tracked in git:", leaked); process.exit(1); } console.log("✅ Git hygiene check passed (0 internal/Linear/secret files tracked).");' && npm run qa && npm test
